testCase:
T-10: Select rows, then a bulk action
Goal: Archive the invoices INV-1003, INV-1007 and INV-1012.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/t-10/
STEP 2: Check "INV-1003" and "INV-1007" on page 1
STEP 3: Click "Next" and check "INV-1012"
STEP 4: Click "Archive selected (3)"
STEP 5: Verify "Archived 3 invoices: INV-1003, INV-1007, INV-1012" is visible

steps.note: Select the first invoice on page 1.
Select the second invoice on page 1.
Archive the three selected invoices together.
Verify the exact confirmation identifies all three invoices.

reasoning: This tests selecting invoices across pagination and archiving them together. The plan selects the specified invoices on both pages and checks the exact confirmation to verify the bulk action succeeded.
